Google Play Diwali Challenge : Get ready to win some cool prizes this festive season with Google Play. Participate for a chance to meet Dhoni and top gamers, and win flagship Android hardware, high-value vouchers, premium gaming accessories and more. Rewards are split by your Play Points level. Platinum level rewards are for Platinum members, and the Gold or above rewards are open to Gold members and higher.
Quantity is the number of winners for each reward, as shown on the event page on 30 October 2026.
How to Participate in the Google Play Diwali Challenge
Open the Google Play Diwali event page and sign in with your Google account.
Make sure you are a Google Play Points member at Gold level or above. Join the program in the Play Store if you are not.
Choose the reward you want. Platinum members can pick Platinum rewards, and Gold or above rewards are for Gold members and higher.
Follow the on-screen steps to apply for your chosen reward. A short question or survey may appear, if available.
Apply before 10 November, 11:59 PM IST, and keep an eye on your email (and spam) after 14 November.
We have not signed in to try the application steps, so the exact steps may differ slightly on the page.
Google Play Points is a rewards program that lets you earn points and benefits for purchases made on Google Play. Based on the points you earn, there are four membership levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum. Each level offers different rewards and benefits.
You need to be a Google Play Points member. The event page marks it as Gold or above, with Platinum level rewards for Platinum members and Gold or above rewards for Gold members and higher.
The contest runs from 28 October (8:00 AM IST) to 10 November (11:59 PM IST) 2026.
Winners are notified by email after 14 November. Check your spam folder too. Prizes are delivered after collecting the necessary details from winners.
A Play Points level upgrade can take up to 2 to 3 business days to show correctly on the Perks website, so upgrade early.
Rewards include a Dhoni VIP Meet and Greet Pass, Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, DJI Osmo Pocket 4, Pixel Watch 5, Sonos Ace headphones, creator meet and greet passes, Galaxy Buds4 Pro, a gaming chair and Lollapalooza India tickets.
No. This event gives the prizes listed above to winners only. For free redeem codes, see our daily Google Play redeem codes post.
These answers are from our earlier Play Points event posts. The same style of rules often repeats, but please check the current event page before relying on them.
Sign in to the website using your Google account and complete the membership registration. Based on your Google Play Points level, you can apply for rewards available at your level and the levels below it. For example, Gold members can apply for Gold, Silver and Bronze rewards. At the top of the event page, you can view the remaining event duration, the number of rewards you have entered and the remaining entry tickets.
In earlier events, your level was determined at 09:00 AM (IST) on the day before the event starts, and a level upgrade took 2 to 3 business days to reflect on the Perks website. To stay eligible, you had to keep the same or a higher level for 15 days after the application period ended.
In earlier events: sign in and register on the website, participate in the reward event, click “Get an entry ticket” below your preferred reward, answer a simple question, and apply for your selected reward. Inviting friends who are Gold or higher members could earn additional tickets.
In earlier events, each participant could earn 1 entry ticket by answering a simple question on the website, and additional tickets by inviting friends who are Gold or higher Google Play Points members.
